title: AW27 Women's Dramatic Presence
summary: Beauty as an answer to hard times: eveningwear codes in daywear, lace, crushed velvet, satin and broad shoulders worn without waiting for a party.
research_period: Pitti Filati, June 2026; Première Vision, Lineapelle and Milano Unica, September 2026; forecaster reports to November 2026

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Pre-runway forecast. The AW27 shows run from January to March 2027. This report is built from the 2026 yarn, fabric and leather fairs (Pitti Filati in June; Première Vision, Lineapelle and Milano Unica in September), published forecaster views and the SS27 runways. Forecut will update it after the shows.

sections.heading: The story
sections.body: Christine Boland's "Dramatic Antidote" and "Unapologetic Presence" seek beauty, seduction and wonder <sup>[1]</sup>. Première Vision's fabric selection came out "silkier and more influenced by eveningwear codes than the teams had anticipated", with satins and crushed velvets <sup>[2]</sup>. Milano Unica's "Romance" adds lurex jacquards, sequin tulle, metallic velvets and lamé tweeds <sup>[1]</sup>.

sections.heading: Colours
sections.body: Deep violet and tannic bordeaux with "sensual black" <sup>[3]</sup> and waxy ochre light.

sections.heading: Silhouettes
sections.body:
- Broad-shouldered jackets over slim skirts.
- Bias satin slips layered over knits.
- All-over lace dresses.
- Skirt suits with ruffled blazers.

sections.heading: Fabrics
sections.body: Satin, crushed and panne velvet, lace, lurex jacquard, lamé tweed.

sections.heading: Trims and details
sections.body: Jewelled buttons, ruffles, lace insets, matte gold and antique silver hardware.

products:
- Evening-to-day dresses, velvet blazers, lace tops, satin skirts.
- Customer: women who dress up "without an occasion".
design_implications: - Back velvet and satin with comfortable linings.
commercial_implications: - Price the hero velvet and lace pieces at premium; keep satin skirts at mid.
